label: M1_mode7_low_rtp
_note: Mode 7 = low-RTP mode (~80% RTP). Mode 1's 'turbulent' counterpart.

Design brief (user 2026-04-22): RTP ~80%. Cut hit rate and low-multiplier (Cherry, mixed-Bar-5×) wins from mode 1. Preserve mid/high multipliers (3-Bar 10-20×, Bar+wild 30-90×, Seven 100+×) — keep volatility / 感性 spike character.

Math: mode 1 is 94.3% RTP / 15.5% hit / CV 5.65 with low 24% / mid 63% / high 13% shares. To reach 80% RTP while preserving absolute mid/high pp, we trim Cherry hits (biggest low-bucket share) and mixed-Bar 5× (second biggest). Mid/high bucket absolute contributions stay nearly identical → same feel on the rare big-win moments.
Low (1-10×):       10.8pp (13.5%)  — cut from mode 1's 24% by chopping Cherry/mixed-Bar
Mid (10-50×):      55.0pp (68.8%)  — preserved in absolute pp (mode 1 had 59pp)
**High (50-500×): 15.2pp (19.0%)** — preserved + slightly boosted; 7 hits still rare events

Player feel: cutting Cherry ~10% → 3% makes base spins feel MORE empty (more zero-return in a row). But when a win hits it's more likely to be a Bar 3-of-kind (10-20×) or bigger — NOT a cherry. Effectively each hit is more meaningful. Loss streaks longer (~P95 25 vs mode 1's 15) — 'turbulent' / 'grindy' feel is real.
CV projected ~ 6.3 (vs mode 1's 5.06). Higher volatility because we cut the averaging Cherry hits but kept the big variance contributions. Matches the brief '保留波动性' (preserve volatility).
Strips are SHARED with mode 1/2/5 (file layout invariant). Only weights differ.
